eps.o: When Gabby's sister Doozie received puppy ears, she and Puggie join Gabby and Pandy on a trip around the Dollhouse.
Doozie's friend CreamPup pops into the Dollhouse, after a mistaken Dollhouse Delivery is delivered to Cakey. CreamPup helps Cakey turn the mix-up into a baking playdate.

Gabby and Pandy take Luli-Loo on a tour around the Dollhouse, while fairysitting her. When it is time for bed, Luli-Loo had forgotten her kitty bear, but Kitty Fairy showed up in the nick of time with it!
It's DJ Catnip's birthday, as Gabby, Pandy and CatRat take DJ on a mystery birthday ride on DJ's groovy party bus to 3 different places: Kittytown in the Wild West, Fairylandia and Birthday Island.
